name: Divine Traits Focus
body:
You have unlocked the secret of a specific divine trait.

Prerequisite: Divine Trait Class Feature

Benefit: Add +2 to your godling class level for determining the effects of one divine trait (regardless of rank) you select when you take this feat; once chosen it cannot be changed.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new divine trait. A godling can select this feat as one of her bonus feats or as a scion talent.
